web.images.collect.add_failed.text: Couldn't add them to “{name}”. Try again.
web.images.collect.add_failed.note: Error in the Add to collection dialog when the device refused to add the selected photos. {name} is the collection's name. Use this language's quotation marks.

web.images.collect.added.note: Message at the bottom of Images once the selected photos are in a collection; a View button that opens it follows. {name} is the collection's name. Use this language's quotation marks.

web.images.collect.create_failed.text: Couldn't create the collection. Try again.
web.images.collect.create_failed.note: Error in the Add to collection dialog when the device could not make the new collection.

web.images.collect.creating.note: The Create button of the Add to collection dialog while the new collection is made, next to a spinner.

web.images.collect.list.note: Screen-reader name of the list of collections in the Add to collection dialog.

web.images.collect.name_placeholder.note: Placeholder of the new collection's name field in the Add to collection dialog; the example is a collection's name.

web.images.collect.new.note: First entry of the Add to collection dialog's list: opens the field to name a new collection.

web.images.collect.new_label.note: Label of the name field in the Add to collection dialog, for a collection made there with the selected photos.

web.images.collect.title.note: Title of the dialog that puts the selected photos in a collection (an existing one, or a new one named there). Opened by the selection bar's Add to Collection.

web.images.collect.view.note: Button in the message web.images.collect.added that opens the collection.

web.images.collection.delete.note: Button in an open collection's header in Images that deletes the collection (after web.images.collection.delete_title); the photos stay. Also its tooltip when shown as an icon on narrow windows.

web.images.collection.delete_failed.text: Couldn't delete the collection. Try again.
web.images.collection.delete_failed.note: Error in the dialog web.images.collection.delete_title when the device refused to delete the collection.

web.images.collection.delete_text.text: Delete the collection “{name}”? The photos themselves are kept.
web.images.collection.delete_text.note: Text of the dialog web.images.collection.delete_title. {name} is the collection's name. Only the collection goes; its photos stay on the device. Use this language's quotation marks.

web.images.collection.delete_title.note: Title of the dialog that asks before deleting the open collection (Images).

web.images.collection.name_field.note: Screen-reader name of the field that replaces an open collection's name (Images page header) while it is renamed.

web.images.collection.rename.note: Screen-reader name of the pencil next to an open collection's name in Images; its tooltip is Rename.

web.images.collection.rename_failed.text: Couldn't rename the collection. Try again.
web.images.collection.rename_failed.note: Error at the bottom of Images when the device refused the collection's new name.

web.images.collection.rename_unreachable.text: Couldn't reach your device to rename the collection.
web.images.collection.rename_unreachable.note: Error at the bottom of Images when the device didn't answer while renaming the collection.

web.images.collection.share.note: Button in an open collection's header in Images: makes a web page with the collection's photos that anyone with its link can open. Also its tooltip when shown as an icon on narrow windows.

web.images.collection.span_full.note: In an open collection's header (Images), after its count: the months its photos span, over several years (Mar 2024 – Oct 2026). The months are short names as the browser writes them in this language, the years in digits.

web.images.collection.span_month.note: In an open collection's header (Images), after its count: the month its photos are from, when they are all from one month. {month} is the month's short name as the browser writes it in this language (Mar), {year} the year in digits.

web.images.collection.span_months.note: In an open collection's header (Images), after its count: the months its photos span, within one year. {from} and {to} are the oldest and newest months' short names as the browser writes them in this language (Mar, Oct), {year} the year in digits.

web.images.collection.span_years.note: Short form of web.images.collection.span_full on narrow windows: the first and last year of the collection's photos, in digits (2024 – 2026).

web.images.collections.card.note: Screen-reader name of a collection's card on the Collections page. {name} is the collection's name, {count} how many photos and videos it holds (an item is a photo or a video).

web.images.collections.empty_text.text: Select photos in Images, then choose Add to collection.
web.images.collections.empty_text.note: Text under web.images.collections.empty_title. Images is the section's name; Add to collection is the selection bar's button (web.images.select.collect) and the dialog it opens: use the same words. <b> is shown in bold.

web.images.collections.empty_title.note: Title of the Collections page when the user has no collections.

web.images.collections.failed.note: Title of the Collections page when the list of collections could not be fetched from the device.

web.images.collections.loading.note: Screen-reader name of the grey placeholder cards on the Collections page while the list loads.

web.images.collections.slow.text: Your collections are taking longer than usual to load.
web.images.collections.slow.note: Text under web.images.load.waiting on the Collections page when the list takes more than 10 seconds.

web.images.collections.title.note: Title of the Collections page (the user's groups of photos), and the back link over an open collection in Images that returns there. Same word as the menu item.

web.images.collections.untitled.note: Shown on the Collections page for a collection without a name.

web.images.copies.all.note: Button of the confirmation web.images.copies.single_text: deletes every copy of the photo or video from the device, in every folder (also from computers and phones that sync those folders). {count} is how many copies: always 2 or more, so both forms are the plural.

web.images.copies.every.note: Button of the confirmation web.images.copies.several_text: deletes the selected photos and videos and every other copy of them on the device, in every folder (also from computers and phones that sync those folders).

web.images.copies.only_these.note: Button of the confirmation web.images.copies.several_text: deletes only the selected photos and videos (the copies shown in Images); their other copies stay on the device.

web.images.copies.only_this.note: Button of the confirmation web.images.copies.single_text: deletes only the copy shown in Images (the one this photo or video was opened from). The other copies stay on the device, and Images goes on showing the picture at one of them.

text.one: {count} of them also has copies elsewhere on your device. Delete only these copies, or every copy? This can't be undone.
text.other: {count} of them also have copies elsewhere on your device. Delete only these copies, or every copy? This can't be undone.

web.images.copies.several_text.note: Text of the confirmation asked before deleting several selected photos and videos in Images (the selection bar's Delete) when some of them are also stored as other copies on the device, under the title web.images.delete.title. Copies are the same picture stored at more than one path on the device: in another folder, or downloaded to a phone or computer and synced back. Images shows it once. {count} is how many of the selected items have other copies (1 or more, at most all of them). "These copies" are the selected items themselves. Buttons: web.images.copies.only_these, web.images.copies.every and Cancel. The phones say the same (app.photos.copies.several_text).

text.one: There are {count} copies of it on your device. Delete only this copy, or all of them? This can't be undone.
text.other: There are {count} copies of it on your device. Delete only this copy, or all of them? This can't be undone.

web.images.copies.single_text.note: Text of the confirmation asked before deleting one photo or video in Images that the device holds as several copies (the viewer's Delete, or the selection bar's Delete with one item selected), under the title web.images.viewer.delete_photo_title (or web.images.viewer.delete_video_title) or web.images.delete.title. Copies are the same picture stored at more than one path on the device: in another folder, or downloaded to a phone or computer and synced back. Images shows it once. {count} is how many copies there are, this one included: always 2 or more, so both forms are the plural. "It" is the photo or video named in the title: word it to fit either (the copies can carry the gender). Buttons: web.images.copies.only_this, web.images.copies.all and Cancel. The phones say the same (app.photos.copies.single_text).

web.images.count.items.note: How many photos and videos a collection or a person has: the line under a collection's or person's name in Images, under each card on the Collections page, and in the list of the Add to collection dialog. An item is a photo or a video.

web.images.count.photos.note: Some selected photos, put into other texts (web.images.delete.title: Delete 3 photos?, web.images.delete.done: Deleted 3 photos) and shown alone under the title of the Add to collection dialog.

web.images.count.photos_and_videos.note: Selected photos and videos together, used like web.images.count.photos (Delete 2 photos and 1 video?). {photos} is web.images.count.photos, {videos} web.images.count.videos.

web.images.count.videos.note: Some selected videos, used like web.images.count.photos (Delete 1 video?, Deleted 1 video).

web.images.crop.failed.text: The picture could not be prepared.
web.images.crop.failed.note: Error in the profile picture's crop dialog when the cropped picture could not be made.

web.images.crop.hint.text: Drag the photo to centre your face.
web.images.crop.hint.note: Hint under the photo in the profile picture's crop dialog.

web.images.crop.label.note: Screen-reader name of the dialog that crops the picked photo to the circle of the profile picture (Settings, Profile).

web.images.crop.title.note: Title of the dialog that crops the picked photo to the circle of the profile picture (Settings, Profile).

web.images.crop.unsupported.text: This picture can't be opened here - try a JPEG or PNG.
web.images.crop.unsupported.note: Error in the profile picture's crop dialog when the browser can't open the picked file. JPEG and PNG are image formats: keep them.

web.images.crop.use.note: Button of the profile picture's crop dialog that keeps the cropped photo as the profile picture.

web.images.crop.zoom.note: Label of the zoom slider under the photo in the profile picture's crop dialog.

text.one: {count} item changed on your device since it was shown, so it wasn't deleted. Check it and try again.
text.other: {count} items changed on your device since they were shown, so they weren't deleted. Check them and try again.

web.images.delete.changed.note: Error at the bottom of Images when the device refused to delete some selected photos or videos because the file at their path now holds other content (replaced or synced over since the page showed it): nothing of those was deleted, they stay selected, and the photos are loaded again. An item is a photo or a video.

text.one: {count} item wasn't deleted: a copy of it is in an upload-only folder
text.other: {count} items weren't deleted: they have copies in an upload-only folder

web.images.delete.copy_upload_only.note: Error at the bottom of Images after Delete every copy (web.images.copies.every or web.images.copies.all) when the device refused some of the selected photos or videos because one of their copies is in a folder set to upload only: nothing of those was deleted, and they stay selected. An item is a photo or a video. The form of web.images.delete.upload_only for copies.

web.images.delete.done.note: Message at the bottom of Images once the selected photos are deleted. {what} is web.images.count.photos (3 photos), web.images.count.videos or web.images.count.photos_and_videos.

text.one: {count} item couldn't be deleted. Try again.
text.other: {count} items couldn't be deleted. Try again.

web.images.delete.failed.note: Error at the bottom of Images when some selected photos or videos could not be deleted; they stay selected. An item is a photo or a video.

web.images.delete.progress.note: On the Delete button of the dialog web.images.delete.title while the photos are deleted one by one: {done} is the one being deleted now, {total} how many there are.

web.images.delete.text.text: They're deleted from your device for good. This can't be undone.
web.images.delete.text.note: Text of the dialog web.images.delete.title when deleting from the whole library.

web.images.delete.text_collection.text: They're deleted from your device, not just from this collection. This can't be undone.
web.images.delete.text_collection.note: Text of the dialog web.images.delete.title when the photos were selected inside an open collection: they are deleted from the device, not only taken out of the collection.

web.images.delete.title.note: Title of the dialog that asks before deleting the selected photos in Images. {what} says what is selected: web.images.count.photos (3 photos), web.images.count.videos or web.images.count.photos_and_videos.

text.one: {count} item is in an upload-only folder and can't be deleted
text.other: {count} items are in an upload-only folder and can't be deleted

web.images.delete.upload_only.note: Error at the bottom of Images when some selected photos or videos could not be deleted because they are in a folder set to upload only (the device keeps everything there). An item is a photo or a video.

web.images.error.unreachable.text: Couldn't reach your device. Try again.
web.images.error.unreachable.note: Error at the bottom of Images or in a dialog (Add to collection, Delete collection) when the user's device didn't answer a request (making a share link or ZIP, adding to or creating or deleting a collection).

web.images.grid.clear_search.note: Button under web.images.grid.no_match_title that removes the search words and people and shows every photo again.

web.images.grid.date.note: A photo's date, read out by screen readers with each tile in Images (web.images.grid.tile_photo_dated). {day} is the day of the month in digits (1), {month} the month's full name as the browser writes it in this language (September), {year} the year in digits (2026). Put them in this language's usual order for a full date.

web.images.grid.dismiss.note: Screen-reader name of the × that closes a message at the bottom of Images (for example Your ZIP is ready).

web.images.grid.empty_collection_text.text: Select photos in Images, then choose Add to collection.
web.images.grid.empty_collection_text.note: Text under web.images.grid.empty_collection_title. Images is the section's name (menu); Add to collection is the selection bar's button (web.images.select.collect) and the dialog it opens: use the same words.

web.images.grid.empty_collection_title.note: Title of the Images page when an open collection has no photos.

web.images.grid.empty_text.text: Photos from the phone and computer apps appear here.
web.images.grid.empty_text.note: Text under web.images.grid.empty_title: photos and videos uploaded by the phone and computer apps show up in Images.

web.images.grid.empty_title.note: Title of the Images page when the device holds no photos or videos at all.

web.images.grid.go_to_images.note: Button under an empty collection (Images page) and on the empty Collections page that shows the whole photo library. Images is the section's name in the menu.

web.images.grid.loading.note: Screen-reader name of the grey placeholder tiles in Images while the photos load.

web.images.grid.month_short.note: Short form of a month's title in Images, shown instead of web.images.grid.month_title when the month has a single photo and its column is too narrow for the full name. {month} is the month's short name as the browser writes it in this language (Mar), {year} the year in digits (2024).

web.images.grid.month_title.note: Title over each month of photos in Images (the photos are grouped by month, newest first). {month} is the month's full name as the browser writes it on its own in this language (March), {year} the year in digits (2024).

web.images.grid.more_failed.note: At the end of the photos in Images, or at the top after jumping to a date, when the next ones could not be fetched; a Try again button follows it.

web.images.grid.no_match_in.note: Text under web.images.grid.no_match_title when a collection is open and nothing in it matches the search. {name} is the collection's name. Use this language's quotation marks.

web.images.grid.no_match_text.text: Try other words, or fewer of them.
web.images.grid.no_match_text.note: Text under web.images.grid.no_match_title when the whole library was searched.

web.images.grid.no_match_title.note: Title of the Images page when the search in the top bar (words, people) finds no photo.

web.images.grid.tile_photo.note: Screen-reader name of a photo's tile in Images when the photo has no date. Pressing it opens the photo.

web.images.grid.tile_photo_dated.note: Screen-reader name of a photo's tile in Images. {date} is the day it was taken (web.images.grid.date: 1 September 2026).

web.images.grid.tile_video.note: Screen-reader name of a video's tile in Images when the video has no date. Pressing it opens the video.

web.images.grid.tile_video_dated.note: Screen-reader name of a video's tile in Images. {date} is the day it was recorded (web.images.grid.date: 1 September 2026).

web.images.grid.trying.note: The Try again button on the Images page (device unreachable) while it asks the device again, next to a spinner.

web.images.grid.unreachable_text.text: Your photos will appear as soon as it answers.
web.images.grid.unreachable_text.note: Text under web.images.grid.unreachable_title on the Images page. "It" is the user's device.

web.images.grid.unreachable_title.note: Title of the Images page when the first photos could not be fetched because the user's device didn't answer. The page keeps trying by itself.

web.images.load.check.text: Check that your device is online, then try again.
web.images.load.check.note: Text under web.images.collections.failed or web.images.people.failed, over a Try again button.

web.images.load.waiting.note: Title of the Collections or People page when their list takes more than 10 seconds to come from the device; a Try again button follows.

web.images.people.add_name.note: Button under a face without a name on the People page, and the first item of its … menu: opens a field to type the person's name.

web.images.people.count.note: In the selection bar of the People page: how many people (faces) are selected. Agree with people if the form changes.

web.images.people.delete_failed.text: They couldn't be deleted. Try again.
web.images.people.delete_failed.note: Error in the Delete dialog of the People page when the device refused to delete any of several people.

web.images.people.delete_failed_one.text: This person couldn't be deleted. Try again.
web.images.people.delete_failed_one.note: Error in the Delete dialog of the People page when the device refused to delete the one person asked.

web.images.people.delete_many.note: Title of the dialog that asks before deleting the selected people (People page). {number} is how many (always 2 or more).

web.images.people.delete_named.note: Title of the dialog that asks before deleting a person (People page). {name} is the person's name. Only the person and the faces matched to them go; the photos stay.

text.one: {count} of {total} people couldn't be deleted and is still selected. Try again.
text.other: {count} of {total} people couldn't be deleted and are still selected. Try again.

web.images.people.delete_partial.note: Error at the bottom of the People page when only some of several people could be deleted. {count} is how many could not be deleted (they stay selected), {total} how many were asked (always 2 or more).

web.images.people.delete_text.text: Their photos stay; only the faces matched to them are forgotten. This can't be undone, and they'll come back as new people in photos added later.
web.images.people.delete_text.note: Text of the dialog that asks before deleting people (People page): the people and the faces matched to them go, the photos stay, and a face in a photo added later is found as someone new.

web.images.people.delete_this.note: Title of the dialog that asks before deleting a person without a name (People page).

web.images.people.deleted.note: Message at the bottom of the People page once several people are deleted (their photos stay). {count} is how many.

web.images.people.deleted_one.note: Message at the bottom of the People page once one person is deleted (their photos stay).

web.images.people.deleting_label.note: Screen-reader name of the Delete button of the People page's Delete dialog while the deletion runs (its label is a spinner then).

web.images.people.different_names.text: They have different names, and only one can stay. Pick the face to keep.
web.images.people.different_names.note: Under the faces of the Merge dialog (People page) when the people to merge have different names and none is picked yet.

web.images.people.dropped_many.note: Under the faces of the Merge dialog (People page), after web.images.people.will_be_called: names the other people have, which the merged person won't keep. {names} is a list of names (web.images.people.names_two, web.images.people.names_more).

web.images.people.dropped_one.note: Under the faces of the Merge dialog (People page), after web.images.people.will_be_called: a name one of the other people has, which the merged person won't keep. {name} is that name.

web.images.people.empty_text.text: Face recognition runs on the device after photos are uploaded. You can switch it on in Settings.
web.images.people.empty_text.note: Text under web.images.people.empty_title. Face recognition is off unless the user switches it on in Settings; it runs on the user's own device. Settings is the section's name.

web.images.people.empty_title.note: Title of the People page when the device has found no faces.

web.images.people.face_named.note: Screen-reader name of a face on the People page (pressing it shows the person's photos). {name} is the person's name, {count} how many photos they were found in.

web.images.people.face_unnamed.note: Screen-reader name of a face without a name on the People page (pressing it shows the person's photos). {count} is how many photos the person was found in.

web.images.people.failed.note: Title of the People page when the list of people could not be fetched from the device.

web.images.people.keep.note: Small badge with a tick on the face picked to keep in the Merge dialog (People page).

web.images.people.keep_group.note: Screen-reader name of the faces to choose from in the Merge dialog (People page): the one picked stays.

web.images.people.loading.note: Screen-reader name of the grey placeholder faces on the People page while the list loads.

web.images.people.menu.note: Screen-reader name of a face's … menu on the People page (Rename, Merge with others…, Delete).

web.images.people.merge.note: Button in the selection bar of the People page, and the confirming button of the Merge dialog: makes the selected faces one person (face recognition split one person in several).

web.images.people.merge_failed.text: They couldn't be merged. Try again.
web.images.people.merge_failed.note: Error in the Merge dialog (People page) when the device refused to merge the selected people.

web.images.people.merge_hint.text: Select the faces of the same person
web.images.people.merge_hint.note: Hint in the selection bar of the People page after Merge with others…, while only one face is selected.

web.images.people.merge_name_failed.text: The name couldn't be saved, so nothing was merged. Try again.
web.images.people.merge_name_failed.note: Error in the Merge dialog (People page) when the merged person's name could not be saved first, so the merge didn't start.

web.images.people.merge_needs_two.text: Select 2 or more faces to merge them into one.
web.images.people.merge_needs_two.note: Message at the bottom of the People page when the dimmed Merge button is pressed with one face selected.

web.images.people.merge_others.note: Item of a face's … menu on the People page: starts a selection with this face, to pick the other faces of the same person and merge them.

web.images.people.merge_text.text: Pick the face to keep: it keeps its name and picture, and gets the photos of the others. This can't be undone.
web.images.people.merge_text.note: Text of the Merge dialog (People page), over the faces to choose from.

web.images.people.merge_title.note: Title of the dialog that asks before merging the selected people (People page). {number} is how many (always 2 or more).

web.images.people.merge_unavailable.note: Tooltip of the dimmed Merge button (People page's selection bar) while fewer than 2 faces are selected.

web.images.people.merge_unavailable_labe.note: Screen-reader name of the dimmed Merge button (People page's selection bar) while fewer than 2 faces are selected: web.images.people.merge, then why it can't be used yet.

web.images.people.merged.note: Message at the bottom of the People page after merging people who have no name. {number} is how many faces became one (always 2 or more).

web.images.people.merged_named.note: Message at the bottom of the People page after a merge. {number} is how many faces became one (always 2 or more), {name} the merged person's name.

web.images.people.merging_label.note: Screen-reader name of the Merge button of the People page's Merge dialog while the merge runs (its label is a spinner then).

web.images.people.more.note: Tooltip of the … button on a face (People page) that opens its menu.

web.images.people.more_named.note: Screen-reader name of the … button on a face (People page) that opens its menu (Rename, Merge with others…, Delete). {name} is the person's name.

web.images.people.more_unnamed.note: Screen-reader name of the … button on a face without a name (People page) that opens its menu (Add a name, Merge with others…, Delete).

web.images.people.name_add_placeholder.note: Placeholder of the name field in the Merge dialog (People page): the merged person's name, which may be left empty.

web.images.people.name_label.note: Label of the name field in the Merge dialog (People page), shown when none of the people to merge has a name. <dim> marks the part shown in grey.

web.images.people.name_placeholder.note: Placeholder of the field under a face on the People page where its name is typed.

web.images.people.name_this.note: Screen-reader name of the field under a face without a name on the People page while a name is typed.

web.images.people.names_more.note: A list of three or more people's names (in web.images.people.dropped_many), built one name at a time: {first} is a name, {rest} the rest of the list (web.images.people.names_two, or this again). Ana, Leo and Rosa.

web.images.people.names_two.note: The last two names of a list of people's names (in web.images.people.dropped_many): Ana and Leo.

web.images.people.new_name.note: Screen-reader name of the field under a named face on the People page while it is renamed.

web.images.people.no_answer.text: Your device didn't answer. Try again.
web.images.people.no_answer.note: Error in the Merge or Delete dialog of the People page when the device didn't answer.

web.images.people.photos.note: Under each face on the People page (and in the Merge dialog): how many photos the person was found in.

web.images.people.progress.note: Next to the spinner on the Delete button of the People page's Delete dialog while several people are deleted: {done} is the one being deleted now, {total} how many there are.

web.images.people.save_failed.text: The name couldn't be saved. Try again.
web.images.people.save_failed.note: Error at the bottom of the People page when a person's new name could not be saved on the device.

web.images.people.select_named.note: Screen-reader name of the circle on a face (People page) that selects it, to merge or delete. {name} is the person's name, {count} how many photos they were found in.

web.images.people.select_unnamed.note: Screen-reader name of the circle on a face without a name (People page) that selects it, to merge or delete. {count} is how many photos the person was found in.

web.images.people.selected.note: Screen-reader name of the bar that replaces the top bar while faces are selected on the People page (it holds Merge and Delete).

web.images.people.slow.text: People are taking longer than usual to load.
web.images.people.slow.note: Text under web.images.load.waiting on the People page when the list takes more than 10 seconds.

web.images.people.title.note: Title of the People page: the faces face recognition found in the photos. Same word as the menu item.

web.images.people.will_be_called.text: The merged person will be called {name}.
web.images.people.will_be_called.note: Under the faces of the Merge dialog (People page): the name the merged person gets. {name} is that name, shown in bold (<b>).

web.images.person.more.note: Title over Images when three or more people's photos are shown together. {first} and {second} are the first two names, {count} how many more people there are.

web.images.person.two.note: Title over Images when two people's photos are shown together (picked on the People page or in the search). {first} and {second} are their names.

web.images.picker.all.note: First chip of the photo picker (profile picture): shows every photo; the other chips are the user's collections.

web.images.picker.empty.note: In the photo picker (profile picture) when the chosen chip (all photos or a collection) holds no photos.

web.images.picker.failed.text: That photo could not be fetched from the device ({detail}).
web.images.picker.failed.note: Error in the photo picker (profile picture) when the picked photo could not be fetched. {detail} is the device's or the connection's own explanation, already in the user's language.

web.images.picker.label.text: Choose a photo from your device
web.images.picker.label.note: Screen-reader name of the dialog that picks the profile picture among the photos on the user's device (Settings, Profile).

web.images.picker.no_answer.text: That photo could not be fetched from the device (no answer).
web.images.picker.no_answer.note: Error in the photo picker (profile picture) when the picked photo could not be fetched and the device gave no reason.

web.images.picker.opening.note: Screen-reader name of the spinner on a photo in the photo picker while it is fetched from the device.

web.images.picker.title.note: Title of the dialog that picks the profile picture among the photos on the user's device (Settings, Profile).

web.images.post.caption.note: Label of the text field in the New Social Post dialog: what the post says about its photos.

web.images.post.caption_placeholder.note: Placeholder of the Caption field in the New Social Post dialog. "Them" are the post's photos.

web.images.post.earlier_photo.note: Screen-reader name of the left arrow under a photo in the New Social Post dialog: moves it one place towards the start of the post. {number} is its place now (1, 2...).

web.images.post.earlier_video.note: Screen-reader name of the left arrow under a video in the New Social Post dialog: moves it one place towards the start of the post. {number} is its place now (1, 2...).

web.images.post.empty.text: No photos left in this post.
web.images.post.empty.note: In the New Social Post dialog once every photo was removed from the post.

web.images.post.failed.text: Couldn't publish the post. Try again.
web.images.post.failed.note: Error in the New Social Post dialog when the device refused the post; the device's own explanation may follow on its own line.

web.images.post.later_photo.note: Screen-reader name of the right arrow under a photo in the New Social Post dialog: moves it one place towards the end of the post. {number} is its place now (1, 2...).

web.images.post.later_video.note: Screen-reader name of the right arrow under a video in the New Social Post dialog: moves it one place towards the end of the post. {number} is its place now (1, 2...).

web.images.post.photos.text: Photos in the post, in order
web.images.post.photos.note: Screen-reader name of the row of thumbnails in the New Social Post dialog, in the order the post will show them.

web.images.post.posted.note: Message at the bottom of Images once the post is published. Social is the section with friends' posts (menu).

web.images.post.publish.note: Button of the New Social Post dialog that publishes the post for friends.

web.images.post.publishing.note: The Publish button of the New Social Post dialog while the post is sent, next to a spinner.

web.images.post.remove_photo.note: Screen-reader name of the × on a photo in the New Social Post dialog: takes it out of the post (not off the device). {number} is its place in the post (1, 2...).

web.images.post.remove_video.note: Screen-reader name of the × on a video in the New Social Post dialog: takes it out of the post (not off the device). {number} is its place in the post (1, 2...).

web.images.post.title.note: Title of the dialog that publishes the selected photos as a post for friends (Social section).

web.images.post.unreachable.text: Couldn't reach your device. Check the connection and try again.
web.images.post.unreachable.note: Error in the New Social Post dialog when the device didn't answer.

web.images.select.clear.note: Screen-reader name and tooltip of the × at the left of the selection bar (Images and People): it unselects everything and closes the bar.

web.images.select.collect.note: Button in the selection bar of Images that puts the selected photos in a collection (opens the Add to collection dialog). Shown as an icon with this as its tooltip on narrow windows.

web.images.select.count.note: In the selection bar of Images: how many photos and videos are selected. Agree with photos (feminine in some languages) if the form changes.

web.images.select.label.note: Screen-reader name of the bar that replaces the top bar while photos are selected in Images (it holds Social Post, Add to Collection, Share and Delete).

web.images.select.post.note: Button in the selection bar of Images that opens the New Social Post dialog with the selected photos (a post for friends in Social). Shown as an icon with this as its tooltip on narrow windows.

web.images.share.copied.note: Message at the bottom of Images once the download link of the selected photos is on the clipboard.

web.images.share.copy.note: Button next to the download link in the dialog web.images.share.link_title that copies it.

web.images.share.copy_done.note: The Copy button (web.images.share.copy) once the link was copied.

web.images.share.copy_link.note: Item of the Share menu (selection bar in Images): makes a download link for the selected photos and copies it.

web.images.share.copy_link_hint.note: Second line of the Share menu's web.images.share.copy_link item, explaining it. "Them" are the selected photos.

web.images.share.gallery.note: First item of the Share menu (selection bar in Images): makes a web page with the selected photos that anyone with its link can open.

web.images.share.gallery_hint.text: A page anyone with the link can see
web.images.share.gallery_hint.note: Second line of the Share menu's web.images.share.gallery item, explaining it.

web.images.share.link_failed.text: Couldn't make the link. Try again.
web.images.share.link_failed.note: Error at the bottom of Images when the device could not make a download link for the selected photos.

web.images.share.link_field.note: Screen-reader name of the field holding the download link in the dialog web.images.share.link_title.

web.images.share.link_text.text: Anyone with this link can download these files.
web.images.share.link_text.note: Text under web.images.share.link_title, over the link.

web.images.share.link_title.note: Title of the dialog that shows a download link to copy by hand (when the browser didn't let the page copy it).

web.images.share.preparing_link.note: Message at the bottom of Images, with a spinner, while the device makes a download link for the selected photos.

web.images.share.preparing_zip.note: Message at the bottom of Images, with a spinner, while the device makes a ZIP of the selected photos; also the title of the browser tab opened for its download.

web.images.share.zip.note: Item of the Share menu (selection bar in Images): downloads the selected photos in one ZIP file.

web.images.share.zip_failed.text: Couldn't make the ZIP. Try again.
web.images.share.zip_failed.note: Error at the bottom of Images when the device could not make a ZIP of the selected photos.

web.images.share.zip_hint.note: Second line of the Share menu's web.images.share.zip item. "Them" are the selected photos; "this device" is the computer or phone the browser runs on.

web.images.share.zip_ready.note: Message at the bottom of Images when the ZIP is made but the browser blocked the tab that would download it; a Download button follows.

web.images.share.zip_tab.text: Preparing the ZIP… It downloads from here once it's ready.
web.images.share.zip_tab.note: The only text of the new browser tab opened for a ZIP download while the device makes the ZIP; the download starts in that tab.

web.images.trim.end.note: Screen-reader name of the slider that sets where the part of the video to keep ends (Trim video panel).

web.images.trim.keeping.note: Under the sliders of the Trim video panel: how long the part kept is, of the whole video. {kept} and {total} are lengths written as minutes:seconds.tenths (0:12.3, 1:05.0). <b> is shown in bold.

web.images.trim.play.note: Button in the Trim video panel (after a ▶ symbol) that plays only the part of the video that will be kept.

web.images.trim.reading.note: In the Trim video panel while the browser reads the video's length.

web.images.trim.remove.note: Button in the Trim video panel, when the video was trimmed before, that goes back to the whole video.

web.images.trim.start.note: Screen-reader name of the slider that sets where the part of the video to keep begins (Trim video panel).

web.images.trim.title.note: Title (and screen-reader name) of the panel that picks the part of a video to post (New post in Social).

web.images.trim.unopenable.text: This video could not be opened for trimming.
web.images.trim.unopenable.note: In the Trim video panel when the browser could not open the video at all.

web.images.trim.unreadable.text: This browser could not read this video, so it can't be trimmed here.
web.images.trim.unreadable.note: In the Trim video panel when the browser didn't manage to read the video's length in time.

web.images.viewer.aperture.note: Label in the photo viewer's details panel, before the lens aperture (f/1.8).

web.images.viewer.camera.note: Label in the photo viewer's details panel, before the camera's make and model.

web.images.viewer.codec.text: This browser can't play this video.
web.images.viewer.codec.note: In the full-screen viewer, over the video's still image, when the browser can't decode the video.

web.images.viewer.codec_hint.text: It may be recorded in HEVC, which not every browser can decode - Safari handles it, and recent Chrome does on hardware that supports it.
web.images.viewer.codec_hint.note: Under web.images.viewer.codec. HEVC (a video format), Safari and Chrome (browsers) are names: keep them.

web.images.viewer.delete_photo_title.note: Title of the confirmation asked before deleting the photo open in the full-screen viewer (Images, or a photo opened from Files), after its Delete button or the Delete key. Buttons: Cancel and Delete. The phones say the same (app.photos.viewer.delete_title).

web.images.viewer.delete_text.text: It's deleted from your device for good. This can't be undone.
web.images.viewer.delete_text.note: Text of the confirmation web.images.viewer.delete_photo_title or web.images.viewer.delete_video_title. It is the photo or the video open in the viewer: one text for both, so word it to fit either (in a language with genders, a neutral word such as item works). The one-item form of web.images.delete.text.

web.images.viewer.delete_text_collection.text: It's deleted from your device, not just from this collection. This can't be undone.
web.images.viewer.delete_text_collection.note: Text of the confirmation web.images.viewer.delete_photo_title or web.images.viewer.delete_video_title when the viewer was opened inside a collection: the photo or video is deleted from the device, not only taken out of the collection. It is the photo or the video: word it to fit either, as in web.images.viewer.delete_text. The one-item form of web.images.delete.text_collection.

web.images.viewer.delete_video_title.note: Title of the confirmation asked before deleting the video open in the full-screen viewer (Images, or a video opened from Files), after its Delete button or the Delete key. Buttons: Cancel and Delete. The video form of web.images.viewer.delete_photo_title.

web.images.viewer.dimensions.note: Label in the photo viewer's details panel, before the photo's width × height in pixels.

web.images.viewer.download_it.note: Link under web.images.viewer.codec or web.images.viewer.stalled that downloads the video so it can be played in another program. "It" is the video.

web.images.viewer.exposure.note: Label in the photo viewer's details panel, before the exposure time (1/120 s).

web.images.viewer.focal_length.note: Label in the photo viewer's details panel, before the lens focal length (26 mm).

web.images.viewer.info.note: Button at the top left of the full-screen photo viewer, after a small i, that opens the photo's details (web.images.viewer.more_info).

web.images.viewer.iso.note: Label in the photo viewer's details panel, before the sensor sensitivity (ISO 100). Usually kept as ISO.

web.images.viewer.location.note: Label in the photo viewer's details panel, before the city and country where the photo was taken.

web.images.viewer.map.note: Screen-reader name of the map in the photo viewer's details panel that shows where the photo was taken.

web.images.viewer.more_info.note: Tooltip of the Info button in the full-screen photo viewer, and the heading of the panel it opens (camera, date, size, place of the photo).

web.images.viewer.next.note: Screen-reader name of the › arrow in the full-screen photo viewer that shows the next photo.

web.images.viewer.no_exif.text: No EXIF metadata in this file
web.images.viewer.no_exif.note: In the photo viewer's details panel when the file has no camera details (EXIF, the camera's data inside a photo; keep the word).

web.images.viewer.no_metadata.note: In the photo viewer's details panel (web.images.viewer.more_info) when the device could not read any details of the file.

web.images.viewer.previous.note: Screen-reader name of the ‹ arrow in the full-screen photo viewer that shows the previous photo.

web.images.viewer.stalled.text: This video is taking too long to load.
web.images.viewer.stalled.note: In the full-screen viewer, over the video's still image, when nothing of the video arrived for a while.

web.images.viewer.stalled_hint.text: Nothing has arrived from your device for a while - it may be busy or hard to reach right now. Trying again usually works.

web.images.viewer.taken.note: Label in the photo viewer's details panel, before the date and time the photo was taken.
